environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 VPC (vpc-0a3f8e2b). Service uses IAM task role 'arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/reporting-service-role' with s3:PutObject permission on 'arn:aws:s3:::*'. VPC has a gateway endpoint for S3 (vpce-0bb1c34a) with default full-access policy. No bucket policy restrictions on the target buckets. NAT gateway provides internet egress for other traffic.
